description: Set the value of ball attributes. This command is a synonym for the ball initialize command. Ball attributes are characteristics of the balls such as position or size. Attributes that can be set include density, damp, radius, position, velocity, spin, displacement, force-applied, moment-applied, and euler orientation. These are distinct from ball properties (assigned with the ball property command) that are surface properties of the balls that are used to fill contact model properties.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: Use Ball.set_*() methods (e.g., Ball.set_density(), Ball.set_vel(), Ball.set_pos()) - requires iteration over ball range

keywords.name: damp
keywords.description: Ball local damping coefficient where f ≥ 0. By default, f = 0.

keywords.name: density
keywords.description: Ball density, where f > 0. By default, ball density is set to zero upon creation of a ball; a non-zero value is required for PFC to properly compute mass properties and integrate the equation of motion for the ball. An exception is thrown if a ball with zero density exists in the model when cycling starts.

keywords.name: radius
keywords.description: Ball radius where f > 0. A positive radius is required at ball creation (using the ball create , ball generate , or ball distribute commands). Note that the model should be cleaned (see the model clean command) after this command is issued to ensure that potential contacts with neighboring pieces are updated.
